title: Follow-up trim on Prescriptions & Renewals replacement fills for overdue visits
content:
Patient Services Center desk guidance — Prescriptions & Renewals.

**Rule.** A follow-up trim applies to a replacement fill: where the patient's latest completed in-person visit with the prescribing department was more than 270 days before the day of the replacement and no visit with that department is booked or confirmed, the trim is 21 days; where that visit was more than 270 days before and a visit with that department is booked or confirmed, the trim is 7 days; otherwise there is no trim (0 days).

**Records read.** Both conditions are read from the patient's In-Person Appointments with the department of the prescriber on this prescription:
- the latest appointment recorded as completed — a Virtual Care visit is not an in-person visit; a patient with no completed in-person visit with that department is in the same position as one whose last such visit was more than 270 days before;
- any appointment with that department recorded as booked or confirmed.

**Figures.**

| Latest completed in-person visit with the prescribing department | A visit with that department booked or confirmed | Trim |
|---|---|---|
| more than 270 days before | no | 21 days |
| more than 270 days before | yes | 7 days |
| 270 days before or less | either | 0 days |

**Edges (hypothetical).**
- Last completed in-person visit exactly 270 days before the replacement: no trim.
- 271 days before, with nothing booked: 21 days; with a confirmed visit next month: 7 days.
- No completed in-person visit with the department at all, and a booked visit: 7 days.
